producer_report.summary: An easy job whose accepted Behavior criterion names a failing run without the fix is now planned in `hard` mode, so Athena runs the demonstration and shows it to the verifier. Root cause: the planning gate in `Athena::dispatch` looked only at `hard_reason`. An easy job got no plan, and Athena runs a "fails without the fix" demonstration only from an accepted plan. The gate now passes `hard_reason.is_some() || asks_for_failing_run(&reading)` to `JobPlanConfig::plans`. `asks_for_failing_run` is a private, doc-commented helper. It matches four fixed phrases ("fails without the fix", "fail without the fix", "fails without the change", "fails without the mechanism") on lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed Behavior criterion text. `enabled = false`, `mode = \"all\"` and the pinned-repository exception behave as before, and the producer model and effort are untouched. I added four core tests (planned with the revert-run record in the verifier prompt; a wording table; an ordinary job skipped; ordinary wordings and a Content criterion skipped) and two CLI tests under the repository's real `[job_plan]` table. I also added a section 9 paragraph in the job-planning design doc, a CHANGELOG entry, and doc-comment edits on `PlanMode::Hard` and `JobPlanConfig::plans`. With the gate reverted, the two planned-job core tests fail on the role order; with an always-true gate, the two ordinary-job tests fail.

mistakes: The first run of the core tests failed because the fake verifier did not cite a command for the Behavior criterion (job Rejected, extra Reader call); fixed in with_criterion.
learnings: A Behavior criterion in the core fake job is met only if the fake verifier cites a command and also lists it in turn.commands_run; otherwise the job is Rejected and a retry reader call appears after the verifier. The wrapper with_criterion sets both for behavior criteria.
The CLI fixture's default reading already lands under a planned path with a Behavior criterion, so changing acceptance_criteria[1].text is enough to trigger the new gate there.
In the core tests the demo seam runs through crate::run::checks::demo_seam::install; with it unset, a planned job records no demonstration.
